title: Water Flow - Max. Delivery Velocity vs. Pipe Size
description: Recommended maximum flow velocities in water systems on the delivery side of the pump. Use this tool to find the maximum recommended velocity for a given pipe size (NPS).

outputs.label: Max. Delivery Velocity
outputs.formula: inputs.pipe_size_nps == 1 ? 1 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 2 ? 1.1 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 3 ? 1.15 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 4 ? 1.25 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 6 ? 1.5 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 8 ? 1.75 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 10 ? 2 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 12 ? 2.65 : 0

outputs.label: Max. Delivery Velocity
outputs.formula: inputs.pipe_size_nps == 1 ? 3.5 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 2 ? 3.6 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 3 ? 3.8 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 4 ? 4 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 6 ? 4.7 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 8 ? 5.5 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 10 ? 6.5 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 12 ? 8.5 : 0

outputs.label: Pipe Size
outputs.formula: inputs.pipe_size_nps == 1 ? 25 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 2 ? 50 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 3 ? 75 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 4 ? 100 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 6 ? 150 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 8 ? 200 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 10 ? 250 : inputs.pipe_size_nps == 12 ? 300 : 0
